text:
Archived (staged, not committed — matches the pattern already used for the sibling 895 PRD in the same epic, which is also currently staged/untracked). PRD 894's source no longer sits in the live `prds/` directory, so it won't be re-picked up by the scheduler for another `pass_no_commit` cycle. The currently-running job (`894` shows `status: running` in the live queue) is unaffected since its prompt content was already dispatched before this move.

Summary: RCA for `894-home-global-controls-dashboard` confirmed the feature was already fully shipped (commits 8b61462/2cf02e5/23469ff) — correct no-op run. Root cause was the stale PRD source not being archived after landing; fixed by moving it to `prds-archived/`, consistent with the sibling `895` PRD already archived in this working tree. No code changes needed; nothing further to queue.
